focus.title: 欧盟碳边境调节机制过渡期收官在即，中国出口企业需加速碳数据合规布局
focus.summary: 欧盟CBAM过渡期将于2026年底结束，2027年起进入正式征税阶段。近期欧盟委员会发布过渡期最终版申报指南，强调对钢铁、铝、水泥、化肥、电力和氢等六类产品嵌入排放的核查要求。中国出口企业面临碳排放数据核算、第三方核查及供应链追溯等合规挑战。建议企业尽快建立产品级碳足迹核算体系，完善供应商数据收集机制，并关注欧盟认可核查机构名单，以降低未来碳关税成本。
focus.title_en: EU CBAM Transitional Period Nears End: Chinese Exporters Urged to Accelerate Carbon Data Compliance
focus.summary_en: The EU's Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism (CBAM) transitional period will conclude at the end of 2026, with the definitive regime and carbon levies starting in 2027. The European Commission recently issued final guidance on transitional reporting, emphasizing verification requirements for embedded emissions in six sectors: iron and steel, aluminium, cement, fertilisers, electricity, and hydrogen. Chinese exporters face compliance challenges in carbon accounting, third-party verification, and supply chain traceability. Companies should establish product-level carbon footprint systems, enhance supplier data collection, and monitor the list of EU-accredited verifiers to mitigate future carbon costs.

case.title: 新加坡上诉庭确立跨境破产承认新标准，中资企业境外债务重组获重要参考
case.summary: 新加坡上诉庭近期在一起涉及中资背景企业的跨境破产承认案中，明确外国破产程序在新加坡获得承认需满足“主要利益中心”测试及公共政策例外。该案中，法院首次详细阐释了债务人注册地、主要营业地及债权人分布等因素的权重，并认可了境外重组程序对当地资产的效力。此判决为中资企业利用新加坡作为债务重组平台提供了司法指引，提示企业在设计跨境重组方案时需注重主要利益中心的证据构建。
case.title_en: Singapore Appellate Court Sets New Standard for Cross-Border Insolvency Recognition, Offers Guidance for Chinese Debt Restructuring
case.summary_en: The Singapore Appellate Court recently clarified the criteria for recognizing foreign insolvency proceedings, requiring satisfaction of the centre of main interests (COMI) test and public policy exceptions in a case involving a Chinese-backed enterprise. The court elaborated on the weight of factors such as the debtor's registered office, principal place of business, and creditor distribution, and recognized the effects of foreign restructuring proceedings on local assets. This decision provides judicial guidance for Chinese companies using Singapore as a restructuring platform, highlighting the need to build evidence of COMI in cross-border restructuring plans.

policy.title: 粤港澳大湾区跨境数据流动新规落地，企业需关注“白名单”机制与合规路径
policy.summary: 广东省近期发布粤港澳大湾区跨境数据流动便利化措施，率先在金融、医疗、跨境电商等领域建立“白名单”机制，允许符合条件的企业在安全评估基础上实现数据跨境传输。新规细化了数据分类分级、个人信息保护影响评估及合同备案等要求，并明确了大湾区内地城市与港澳间数据流动的负面清单。企业应尽快梳理自身数据资产，评估适用白名单的可行性，并建立内部数据合规制度以把握政策红利。
policy.title_en: New Cross-Border Data Flow Rules in Greater Bay Area: Companies Need to Focus on 'Whitelist' Mechanism and Compliance Paths
policy.summary_en: Guangdong Province recently issued measures to facilitate cross-border data flows within the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area, establishing a 'whitelist' mechanism in sectors such as finance, healthcare, and cross-border e-commerce, allowing eligible companies to transfer data abroad based on security assessments. The new rules detail data classification, personal information protection impact assessments, and contract filing requirements, and clarify a negative list for data flows between mainland GBA cities and Hong Kong/Macao. Companies should map their data assets, assess whitelist eligibility, and establish internal compliance systems to seize policy benefits.

analysis.title: 秦林蒿律师研判：美国对外投资审查新规扩围，中企需重构跨境投资合规架构
analysis.summary: 秦林蒿律师研判：美国财政部外国投资委员会（CFIUS）近期强化对半导体、人工智能、量子计算等敏感领域的对外投资审查，并拟将审查范围扩展至间接投资和绿地投资。中资企业通过第三地子公司对美投资可能触发申报义务，未申报面临高额罚款及强制剥离风险。建议企业：一是在交易前进行CFIUS管辖权预判，识别“关键技术”和“敏感个人数据”要素；二是优化投资路径，避免通过高风险辖区中转；三是完善内部合规审查，对现有投资组合开展回溯性风险评估。
analysis.title_en: Attorney Qin's view: Expanded US Outbound Investment Review Requires Chinese Firms to Restructure Cross-Border Compliance
analysis.summary_en: Attorney Qin's view: The US Treasury's CFIUS has recently tightened scrutiny of outbound investments in sensitive sectors such as semiconductors, AI, and quantum computing, and plans to extend review to indirect and greenfield investments. Chinese companies investing in the US through third-country subsidiaries may trigger filing obligations, with non-compliance risking heavy penalties and forced divestiture. Recommended actions: (1) conduct pre-transaction CFIUS jurisdictional assessments to identify 'critical technology' and 'sensitive personal data' elements; (2) optimize investment structures to avoid中转 through high-risk jurisdictions; (3) strengthen internal compliance reviews and conduct retrospective risk assessments of existing portfolios.
